name: Decode the Emojis
why_it_works: A row of emojis is a rebus anyone can try, and cracking it gives a quick hit of 'I got it'. Because the answer is the title of something coming next, every guess makes people think about the upcoming release, and the hint pulls them back for the reveal.

hook.pattern: Flash a row of emojis that spell out a coming title and dare viewers to decode it.
examples: Decode these emojis. Name our next {{answer_type}}.
A few emojis. One title. Can you crack it?

variables.name: brand
variables.description: Show, artist, team or shop name

variables.name: emoji_clue
variables.description: Three to five emojis that spell out the title; check they render on iPhone and Android

variables.name: answer_type
variables.description: What the title belongs to, one word

variables.name: hint
variables.description: One fair hint, 6 words or fewer
variables.example: a big number for a small show

variables.name: feature_prize
variables.description: What the drawn winner gets, value stated in the official rules, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: deadline
variables.description: When guesses close and the answer drops, 4 words or fewer

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 bold graphic where the emojis {{emoji_clue}} pop in one by one, huge, on a flat {{brand}} color background

beats.voiceover: It's the title of our next {{answer_type}}.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 moody shot of the {{brand}} workspace, one warm practical lamp, a blank title card on the desk, soft haze
The emojis {{emoji_clue}} large on the {{brand}} color background with a faint question mark behind them, vertical 9:16

beats.on_screen_text: Right answers go in a random draw.
beats.voiceover: Every right answer goes in a random draw.

cta: Comment your guess by {{deadline}}. One right answer, drawn at random, gets {{feature_prize}} from {{brand}}. Official rules in our bio.

craft.notes: Aim for a puzzle about one in five people crack: one emoji should be literal, one a pun, one a number. Post the answer and the screen-recorded draw together so the follow-up is its own piece of content.

do_not: Use emojis that only render on one kind of phone
Make it so obscure nobody gets it; nobody comments on a dead end
Pick the winner by likes, favorites or follower count
compliance: Contest rules: link official rules with eligibility, start and end dates, how the winner is picked (random draw from correct answers) and prize value
No purchase necessary; void where prohibited
Say the contest is not sponsored or run by the platform
Pick the winner by random draw only, never by likes, and screen-record the draw
Get the winner's permission before showing their name or handle
